text:
ana: Heads-up — we got 3 customer asks in the last week re: console observability: (1) per-route token/cost breakdown, (2) tracing hooks to link traces to prompt/eval ids, (3) error analytics that surface model regressions. Need to slot into sprint planning. Thoughts?

mike: +1 on cost breakdown, customers keep asking for per-prompt line items.

sara: Agree. For cost, we can add a per-route column in usage table and a small daily agg to show tokens and $.

devon: Tracing hooks: we need to emit trace IDs from runtime. I can add header X-RW-Trace to responses, but backend support needed. Example header: `X-RW-Trace: {{trace_id}}`

ana: @devon is that low effort? what's the rollout risk?

devon: Low effort on runtime (few lines), medium on console UI (needs join with request logs). No backfill — start with new events only. Will also add a small sampling flag to avoid overhead.

katie: For error analytics, customers want grouped error types + sample prompts. Privacy concerns for prompt samples — need opt-in and redaction.

mike: Priority matrix idea: (A) per-route cost (high customer value, low effort), (B) trace header (high value, med effort), (C) error analytics with samples (high value, high effort + compliance).

sara: Proposed launch criteria for per-route cost: 1) daily agg stable for 30 customers, 2) console table + detail page, 3) docs + migration note.

ana: Can we cut scope: initial MVP = per-route daily agg + inline cost column, no historical drilldown, no fancy filtering.

devon: I'll prototype trace header by EOD next Wed. Will open PR referencing issue #4021 and add a quick test:
```
# runtime config snippet
headers.add("X-RW-Trace", trace.id)
```

katie: I'll draft the privacy checklist and opt-in UX copy. Key items: redaction rules, retention window, explicit opt-in toggle, and audit log entry.

ana: Owners: mike=cost, devon=traces, katie=errors. Add to this week's planning. Who can size UI work?

sara: I'll take UI sizing — will post estimates in Asana by Tue.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/free-credit-cleanup -> staging at 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC :rocket:

ana: OK let's sync Tue 10am. Meeting invite going out. :calendar: 

mike: thanks, will prep mockups.

devon: ping @ana when PR opened.

katie: adding compliance review to the board.

ana: thanks all, closing loop.
